## 📝 FAQ Contribution

Thank you for contributing to the Open Food Facts FAQ!

### Summary of Changes
- **Target Language(s)**: [ ] `en` [ ] `fr` [ ] `es` [ ] `de` [ ] `it`
- **Category file**: `data/faq/<lang>/<category>.md`
- **Type of change**:
  - [ ] Adding new question(s)
  - [ ] Updating existing answer
  - [ ] Fixing typo or broken link
  - [ ] Translating existing question to another language

### Related Issue
Closes #<!-- insert issue number if applicable -->

### Quality Checklist
- [ ] Question starts with `## <Question Title>` and answer is formatted in valid Markdown.
- [ ] Checked against validation schema using `python3 scripts/compile_faq.py --check`.
- [ ] Recompiled pages with `python3 scripts/compile_faq.py` (if applicable).
- [ ] Content is factual, up to date, neutral, and links have been verified.
- [ ] Conforms to Open Food Facts community guidelines and open data licensing.
